notes.title: Old Bunny Update
notes.content:
[h2]Big Update has come![/h2]
Meet Old Bunny - a bunny who knows everything! Speak to him and get some tasks. He'll be happy to share the knowledge with you!

[b]Additions[/b]:
- new NPC - Old Bunny
- 50 quests
- solutions to all the puzzles (via quests)
- new interactions and activities on the map: new ring, new flowers, new statues, notes

[b]Fixes[/b]:
- fixed world orientation of one chicken
- now water effect during swimming is client only
- added puzzle names on the map
- now Hatman pointers are visible on the map after activating
- fixed that player position wasn't properly saved and loaded
- fixed missing button dig in the Controls

notes.title: Update 3.1
notes.content:
[list]
[*] added 7 new achievements
[*] changed the way spawn items while digging work: random item is always spawned irrespective of whether you have it or not. If you want to dig spefific item you need to go to the area of the corresponding puzzle name as it was initially planned.
[*] now you can take the item even if it is under ground but the green beam is visible
[*] updated some font glyphs
[/list]

notes.title: Digging Update
notes.content:
Now your bunny can dig!
Dig everywhere on the land and find buried items.
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/o5FNnLu9AoStk83tDU/giphy.gif[/img]

There are 50 items you can unlock. Progress is displayed in the Game menu->Excavated Items

Get 9 new achievement binded to new activity!

P.S. new option cannot save you from your teammates.
